items.title: Walter "Furry" Lewis Interview, 1967-05-03
items.q: I don't know what she did or not. Before she ever hear from her or heard of what she did or not.

ctx.x: That's why my wife would tell you the same thing. I need to get a nickel out of it. No more than that what the people got through making the record like that.
Yeah well. You need to find a good lawyer around here. They'll do something for you. Oh what happened to Memphis Manny?
Well now I'll tell you one thing. I don't know what she did or not. Before she ever hear from her or heard of what she did or not.
